text: なんだ　おめーは　さっきから　ジロジロ　みやがって　やんのか　コラァ！

structure.jp: さっきから　ジロジロ　みやがって
structure.en: staring at us all this time

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる stuck onto a verb is a rude way to show anger or contempt for what the other person is doing. ジロジロ みやがって = 'having the nerve to stare at us'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end is a blunt question that demands an answer. やるのか is slurred to やんのか in rough speech = 'you wanna go at it?'.
